      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "raised concerns about CONSTRUCTOR_ARGUMENT annotations, brace initialization, check naming, and whether making structs immutable is worth it; suggested closing draft"

      "login": "janb84",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "summarized three possible approaches and expressed preference for option B (one class at a time)"

      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; argued structs should be immutable to prevent buggy behavior"
    },
    {
      "login": "alexanderwiederin",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK; noticed dropping witness data; supported manual rewrite approach C"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3801299334",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "manual CONSTRUCTOR_ARGUMENT macro annotations duplicate information and can go stale",
      "quote": "The benefit would be that there is only a single source of truth and this won't go stale. Also, manual marking wouldn't be needed.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied explaining preference against heuristics and suggested alternative approaches where annotations are unnecessary",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3802036505"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3802036505",
      "status_by_quote": "I don't want to build too many heuristics into the clang-tidy check. But depending on how we approach the change, it may be less of an issue or not be needed at all"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3801307204",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "use brace initialization to retain C++11 narrowing checks",
      "quote": "Is there a reason to not use the C++11 narrowing checks for new code? Other places use a static_cast<uint32_t>() for the second arg, and I think this is useful to know about and be explicit.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author confirmed aggregate init wouldn't compile everywhere; reviewer accepted manual updates could be worth it",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3801958788"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3803317221",
      "status_by_quote": "Ok, I see. I wonder if it is worth it to update them manually (either by adding a static_cast, or by updating the outer"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3801324067",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "rename the clang-tidy check to bitcoin-prefer-ctor to avoid confusion",
      "quote": "Given that the was confusion about the name, maybe name it differently?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5328158198",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "questioned the value of expanding immutability to other structs beyond CTransaction, suggesting leaving it as mostly test-only cleanup",
      "quote": "However, for other structs, is there much value/benefit? https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35569 seems a bit controversial, so expanding it to stuff that has even less benefit may not be the best approach?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "purpleKarrot replied arguing types should be immutable with procedural test code rewritten declaratively",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5333773972"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5332099006"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5333773972",
      "status_by_quote": "Those types should be made immutable, with no associated builder (no CMutableTransaction)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3807467505",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "the automated replacement drops witness data",
      "quote": "Does this drop the witness?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed it indeed drops the witness, but no fix push followed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3807633224"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3807633224",
      "status_by_quote": "Indeed."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4965218337",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "whether the checks need to be run to a fixed point or if a single pass is sufficient",
      "quote": "Do the checks here need to be run to a fixed point or is a single pass sufficient?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {

      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add the clang-tidy invocation in commit messages so mechanical changes can be verified",
      "quote": "Might be worth adding the invocation in the commit messages, so the mechanical changes can be verified.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3841942345",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "use init-list in duplicate_inputs.cpp",
      "quote": "should probably use init-list, like https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36019#discussion_r3811388178",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",

      "quote": "CI is red and this draft is inactive for months. I guess it can be closed?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",

      "substantive": true,

    {

      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",

      "areas": []

  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to maflcko's query about closing the PR, and unresolved claims",
      "id": "c:6502436599"
    }
  ],

Added missing suggestions and questions from maflcko and alexanderwiederin."
